description: Forum sections and topics. A section lists its topics; a topic is one discussion thread.

community.section.create.description: Add a forum section and open the list of its topics

community.section.delete.description: Delete a section together with every topic under it

community.topic.create.description: Create a topic in a section and write its opening post

community.topic.set-flags.brief: Pin, lock or archive a topic
community.topic.set-flags.description: Change the moderation flags of one forum topic
